playstyle: Three Stormcast elites with range-2 hammers and 5 Health each, durable for their size but low on bodies, with Leona's Fly and Move 4 the only real mobility. Every fighter also carries a range-3 ranged attack, letting the trio chip at foes before closing in. With no warscroll of its own, it borrows a generic Order one, either seizing treasure in enemy territory or holding its own ground to Inspire. Inspired, they gain Grievous, Ensnare and Cleave, winning by trading efficiently and outlasting foes.
